doc.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Trumpeters Bill Hardman and Tommy Turrentine
summary: He hired Hardman after meeting him in Cleveland, then Turrentine.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who did you take on guitar with you at that time?
I didn’t have a guitar. I took Bill Hardman on trumpet. Then I took Tommy Turrentine on trumpet.
How did you meet Bill Hardman?
Where he was from, where he grew up.
That’s where he was from, yeah. He came by to sit in, and I liked him, so I hired him.
